title: Harrington's Fukushima delegation visit

tellings.quote: out we were with there the guy that led the delegation on what happened and and Fukushima did not kill anybody.

plain: John S. Herrington, who served as US Secretary of Energy, says he went to Fukushima, Japan, in 2011 with a delegation, after the nuclear disaster there. He tells Michels he was with the man who led the delegation, and that "Fukushima did not kill anybody." His point is that the radiation itself was less deadly than people believe.
